text:
sara_sales: Heads-up: NovaGuard RFP dropped. They want a 4-week POC, completed security questionnaire, a concise capability matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and firm POC pricing. Deadline next Friday. RFP PDF: https://company-drive/helios/NovaGuard_RFP_2026.pdf

emily_pm: they list HSM integration, EU data residency, and 7-year audit logs as must-have. Thoughts on POC topology?

ben_se: propose hybrid: immediate Hosted EU smoke to validate flows, then Dedicated for scale tests. Private only if they insist on on-prem keys. Hybrid shortens time-to-demo.

nina_solutions: agree. I'll put together a 1-page capability table that highlights differences in SLAs, network setup, HSM support, expected p95 ranges, and operational notes. Keep it client-ready.

paul_security: for the questionnaire: we can answer SOC2, AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit. HSM: cloud-KMS & KMIP supported; on-prem HSM requires an installation window, network peering, and a signed MSA addendum. I'll draft language for each RFP checkbox.

sara_sales: they also asked for pricing: POC discounted rate, committed Dedicated price, and an option for longer-term extended log retention charges. Can billing-bot prefill numbers?

billing-bot: Draft rates: POC dev tier = 40% off standard gen per-token + flat embedding trial credit. Committed Dedicated = negotiated discount tiers based on monthly token/embedding volume. Extended log retention = additional $X/month per TB (needs legal signoff).

ben_se: perf ask in RFP: 150 qps sustained, 2s p95. We'll need to know avg prompt length and embedding dim. Ask them for a 24-hour sample workload.

nina_solutions: I'll make the matrix point out model tradeoffs: 70B unquantized for quality vs 13B quantized for latency/cost. Include recommended config for 150 qps target.

paul_security: CCPA note: we have user-request workflows and data access logs. EU residency: Hosted region pin + Private option. 7-year logs = non-standard; legal must approve retention & cost.

sara_sales: action items: Ben -> request sample corpus & traffic (today). Nina -> capability matrix draft (tomorrow AM). Paul -> security questionnaire draft (tomorrow). Emily -> coordinate legal for log retention & prepare PO language (today). Billing-bot -> sample pricing worksheet (tomorrow).

ben_se: sample ask to client (will send now): "Can you provide a 24-hour request dump, sample prompts, embedding dims, and which model family you prefer? Also confirm required start date for POC"

nina_solutions: example curl for their engineers to smoke test Hosted while we prep Dedicated:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-13b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize product specs."}]}'
```

paul_security: fallback plan note: if on-prem HSM/peering delays, offer encrypted snapshot replay + EU-hosted demo to validate functional behavior. Document in runbook.

emily_pm: provisioning warning: Dedicated pools require 48-72h after signed PO; Private installs vary (2-4 weeks). We'll surface timeline in the response.

sara_sales: timeline for deliverables: matrix + pricing + security answers in draft by Thursday EOD so legal can review Friday.

ben_se: I'll ping NovaGuard now. Will post the sample data when I get it. :thumbsup:
